facts.business: Kerala Ayurveda Limited is engaged in the business of Ayurveda, including manufacturing and marketing of Ayurvedic medicines, wellness services, and related products through its subsidiaries in India, USA, and Singapore.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on significant trade receivables due from subsidiaries outstanding for more than 6 months with no provision for expected credit loss recognized (Note 16).

key_risks: Significant trade receivables from subsidiaries outstanding over 6 months with no ECL provision
Pervasive related party transactions with risk of incomplete identification and inadequate disclosure
Compliance with arm's length pricing and regulatory requirements for related party transactions
facts.related_party_note: Significant related party transactions with subsidiaries including sale/purchase of goods/services, lending, investment, and borrowing. Transactions with Ayurvedagram Heritage Wellness Centre Pvt Ltd (material subsidiary), Katra Holding Pvt Ltd, and Katra Phytochem (India) Pvt Ltd approved by shareholders. Omnibus approval obtained for repetitive transactions. All RPTs presented to Audit Committee and Board.
